title: 学习式上下文规划未能超越强检索：长上下文问答中规划、路由与重排序的受控研究
summary: 研究测试学习式上下文规划在强检索、路由与重排序控制下对长上下文多选题问答的效果。在LongBench-v2的503题上，锚定混合检索达36.18%，BM25达35.98%，而最佳规划引导方法仅34.19%。在未触碰的152题测试集上，混合检索仍更高（42.11%对36.84%）。结论：学习式规划只是弱相关性信号，无法替代强检索。
summary_en: This study tests whether learned context planning improves long-context multiple-choice QA after strong retrieval, routing, and reranking controls. On 503 LongBench-v2 questions, anchored hybrid retrieval reaches 36.18% and BM25 35.98%, while the best planner-guided method reaches only 34.19%. On the untouched 152-question test split, hybrid retrieval remains higher (42.11% vs 36.84%). Conclusion: learned planning is a weak relevance signal, not a replacement for strong retrieval.
